    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">随机爬树题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="随机爬树题解">随机爬树题解</h1>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/U101804" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">题目传送门</a></p>
<p><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Kx-Triumphs/p/19236463" target="_blank">更好的阅读体验</a></p>
<h2 id="-暴力"><span class="math inline">\(n^2\)</span> 暴力：</h2>
<h3 id="思路">思路：</h3>
<ul>
<li>求期望，即求所有点的权值乘上概率后的和，即：</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[ans=\sum_{u \in V}{P_u a_u}
\]</div><p></p><ul>
<li>
<p>求每个点的概率 <span class="math inline">\(P_u\)</span> ：</p>
<ul>
<li>由题，令走到父亲的概率为 <span class="math inline">\(P_f\)</span>，走到儿子 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span> 的概率则为 <span class="math inline">\(P_f \times \frac{w_s}{sum_f}\)</span>（其中 <span class="math inline">\(sum_f\)</span> 为 <span class="math inline">\(f\)</span> 所有儿子的 <span class="math inline">\(w\)</span> 之和）。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>统计答案：</p>
<ul>
<li>记 <span class="math inline">\(ans_u\)</span> 表示 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 子树（不含 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 本身）的答案之和，最终答案为 <span class="math inline">\(ans_1+a_1\)</span>。</li>
<li>暴力修改，跑 DFS 暴力求和即可。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="代码">代码：</h3>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">//n^2暴力 60pts
#include&lt;iostream&gt;
#include&lt;cstdio&gt;
#include&lt;cstring&gt;
#include&lt;vector&gt;
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int N=1e5+5,Mod=998244353;
int n,q,fa[N];
ll sum[N],inv[N],w[N],a[N];
ll p[N],ans[N];
vector &lt;int&gt; e[N];
ll qpow(ll a,ll b){
    ll res=1;
    while(b){
        if(b&amp;1) (res*=a)%=Mod;
        (a*=a)%=Mod;
        b&gt;&gt;=1;
    }
    return res%Mod;
}
void dfs(int u){
    ans[u]=0;
    inv[u]=qpow(sum[u],Mod-2);
    for(int i=0;i&lt;e[u].size();i++){
        int v=e[u][i];
        p[v]=p[u]*w[v]%Mod*inv[u]%Mod;
        dfs(v);
        (ans[u]+=(ans[v]+p[v]*a[v]%Mod)%Mod)%=Mod;
    }
}
int main(){
    scanf("%d",&amp;n);
    for(int i=2;i&lt;=n;i++){
        scanf("%d",&amp;fa[i]);
        e[fa[i]].push_back(i);
    }
    for(int i=1;i&lt;=n;i++){
        scanf("%lld",&amp;w[i]);
        (sum[fa[i]]+=w[i])%=Mod;
    }
    for(int i=1;i&lt;=n;i++){
        scanf("%lld",&amp;a[i]);
    }
    p[1]=1;
    dfs(1);
    printf("%lld\n",(ans[1]+a[1])%Mod);
    scanf("%d",&amp;q);
    int u;
    ll ww,aa;
    for(int i=1;i&lt;=q;i++){
        scanf("%d",&amp;u);
        sum[fa[u]]=(sum[fa[u]]-w[u]+Mod)%Mod;
        scanf("%lld%lld",&amp;w[u],&amp;a[u]);
        sum[fa[u]]=(sum[fa[u]]+w[u])%Mod;
        dfs(1);
        printf("%lld\n",(ans[1]+a[1])%Mod);
    }

    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="优化后正解">优化后正解：</h2>
<h3 id="思路-1">思路：</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>每次修改 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 只对 <span class="math inline">\(f\)</span> 的整棵子树产生影响，故用线段树维护子树和。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>考虑有哪些影响：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span class="math inline">\(w_u\)</span> 修改为 <span class="math inline">\(ww\)</span>，使得 <span class="math inline">\(sum_f\)</span> 发生改变，故整棵子树的概率都会变化：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>对于 <span class="math inline">\(f\)</span> 子树中每个节点 <span class="math inline">\(t\)</span>（不含 <span class="math inline">\(f\)</span>），原概率为 <span class="math inline">\(P_t=P_{fa_t}\times \frac{w_t}{sum_{fa_t}}\)</span>，修改后变为 <span class="math inline">\(P_t'=P_{fa_t}\times \frac{w_t}{sum_{fa_t}-w_u+ww}\)</span>。</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[P_t'=P_t\times\frac{sum_{fa_t}}{sum_{fa_t}-w_u+ww}
\]</div><p></p><p>则有 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta P=\frac{sum_{fa_t}}{sum_{fa_t}-w_u+ww}\)</span>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>对于点 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span>，原概率为 <span class="math inline">\(P_u=P_f\times \frac{w_u}{sum_f}\)</span>，修改后变为 <span class="math inline">\(P_u'=P_f \times \frac{ww}{sum_f-w_u+ww}\)</span>。</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[P_u'=P_u \times \frac{ww}{wu} \times \Delta P
\]</div><p></p><p>则有 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta w=\frac{ww}{wu}\)</span>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>对于 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 子树中的每个点 <span class="math inline">\(t\)</span>（不含 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span>），原概率为 <span class="math inline">\(P_t=P_{fa_t}\times \frac{w_t}{sum_{fa_t}}\)</span>，修改后变为 <span class="math inline">\(P_t'=P_{fa_t}\times \Delta w \times \frac{w_t}{sum_{fa_t}}\)</span>。</p>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<p><span class="math inline">\(a_u\)</span> 修改为 <span class="math inline">\(aa\)</span>，只对 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 的贡献产生影响，原贡献为 <span class="math inline">\(ans=P_u \times a_u\)</span>，修改后变为 <span class="math inline">\(ans'=P_u \times aa\)</span>，即：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[ans'=ans \times \frac{aa}{au}
\]</div><p></p></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>综上，变化有：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(P_t'=P_t\times\frac{sum_{fa_t}}{sum_{fa_t}-w_u+ww}\)</span>；</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(P_u'=P_u \times \frac{ww}{wu} \times \frac{sum_{fa_t}}{sum_{fa_t}-w_u+ww}\)</span>；</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(P_t'=P_{fa_t}\times \frac{ww}{wu} \times \frac{w_t}{sum_{fa_t}}\)</span>；</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(ans'=ans \times \frac{aa}{au}\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<p>其中操作 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(2\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(2\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(3\)</span> 可以合并。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="代码-1">代码：</h3>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include&lt;iostream&gt;
#include&lt;cstdio&gt;
#include&lt;vector&gt;
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int N=1e5+5,Mod=998244353;
int n,q,fa[N];
ll sum[N],w[N],a[N],p[N],val[N];
int tid,dfn[N],siz[N];
vector &lt;int&gt; e[N];
struct Tree{
    ll sum,tag;
}tr[N&lt;&lt;2];
ll qpow(ll a,ll b){
    ll res=1;
    while(b){
        if(b&amp;1) (res*=a)%=Mod;
        (a*=a)%=Mod;
        b&gt;&gt;=1;
    }
    return res%Mod;
}
ll inv(ll x){
    return qpow(x,Mod-2);
}
void dfs(int u){
    dfn[u]=++tid;
    val[tid]=p[u]*a[u]%Mod;
    siz[u]=1;
    for(int i=0;i&lt;e[u].size();i++){
        int v=e[u][i];
        p[v]=p[u]*w[v]%Mod*inv(sum[u])%Mod;
        dfs(v);
        siz[u]+=siz[v];
    }
}
void update(int k){
    tr[k].sum=(tr[k&lt;&lt;1].sum+tr[k&lt;&lt;1|1].sum)%Mod;
}
void pushdown(int k,int l,int r){
    tr[k&lt;&lt;1].sum=tr[k&lt;&lt;1].sum*tr[k].tag%Mod;
    tr[k&lt;&lt;1].tag=tr[k&lt;&lt;1].tag*tr[k].tag%Mod;
    tr[k&lt;&lt;1|1].sum=tr[k&lt;&lt;1|1].sum*tr[k].tag%Mod;
    tr[k&lt;&lt;1|1].tag=tr[k&lt;&lt;1|1].tag*tr[k].tag%Mod;
    tr[k].tag=1;
}
void build(int k,int l,int r){
    tr[k].sum=0;
    tr[k].tag=1;
    if(l==r){
        tr[k].sum=val[l]%Mod;
        return ;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)&gt;&gt;1;
    build(k&lt;&lt;1,l,mid);
    build(k&lt;&lt;1|1,mid+1,r);
    update(k);
}
void modify(int k,int l,int r,int x,int y,int v){
    if(x&lt;=l&amp;&amp;r&lt;=y){
        tr[k].sum=tr[k].sum*v%Mod;
        tr[k].tag=tr[k].tag*v%Mod;
        return ;
    }
    pushdown(k,l,r);
    int mid=(l+r)&gt;&gt;1;
    if(x&lt;=mid) modify(k&lt;&lt;1,l,mid,x,y,v);
    if(mid&lt;y) modify(k&lt;&lt;1|1,mid+1,r,x,y,v);
    update(k);
}
int main(){
    //freopen("climb2.in","r",stdin);
    //freopen("climb.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&amp;n);
    for(int i=2;i&lt;=n;i++){
        scanf("%d",&amp;fa[i]);
        e[fa[i]].push_back(i);
    }
    for(int i=1;i&lt;=n;i++){
        scanf("%lld",&amp;w[i]);
        sum[fa[i]]=(sum[fa[i]]+w[i])%Mod;
    }
    for(int i=1;i&lt;=n;i++){
        scanf("%lld",&amp;a[i]);
    }
    p[1]=1;
    dfs(1);
    build(1,1,n);
    printf("%lld\n",tr[1].sum%Mod);
    scanf("%d",&amp;q);
    int u;
    ll ww,aa;
    for(int i=1;i&lt;=q;i++){
        scanf("%d%lld%lld",&amp;u,&amp;ww,&amp;aa);
        if(fa[u]){
            /*
            1.f子树(除f本身)：Pt=Pf*(wt/sumf)* (1/(sumf-wu+ww))*sumf
            2.u：pu=pf*(wu/sumf)*(ww/wu)* (1/(sumf-wu+ww))*sumf
            3.u子树(除u本身)：Pt=Pft* (ww/wu) *(wt/sumft)
            */
            //1. 2. 修改f子树(除f本身)
            modify(1,1,n,dfn[fa[u]]+1,dfn[fa[u]]+siz[fa[u]]-1,inv(((sum[fa[u]]-w[u]+ww)%Mod+Mod)%Mod)%Mod*sum[fa[u]]%Mod);
            //2. 3.
            modify(1,1,n,dfn[u],dfn[u]+siz[u]-1,ww*inv(w[u])%Mod);
            sum[fa[u]]=((sum[fa[u]]-w[u]+ww)%Mod+Mod)%Mod;
        }
        w[u]=ww;
        //修改au：Pu*au* (aa/au)
        modify(1,1,n,dfn[u],dfn[u],aa*inv(a[u])%Mod);
        a[u]=aa;
        printf("%lld\n",tr[1].sum%Mod);
    }

    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
